Form field wrapper

Source: R/tier2-form-field.R
shad_form_field.Rd

Wraps a control with a label, help description, and error slot, matching the shadcn form-field anatomy. The bundled JS wires aria-describedby from the description/error elements to the contained control on init. Most Tier 2 constructors reuse this internally when given label/description.

Usage

shad_form_field(
  ...,
  label = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  error = NULL,
  required = FALSE,
  inputId = NULL,
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

...

The control(s) to wrap, plus optional named attributes.

label

Optional field label text.

description

Optional help text shown below the control.

error

Optional error message. When non-NULL the error slot is shown (otherwise it is rendered but hidden, ready for client-side validation).

required

If TRUE, appends a visual required marker to the label.

inputId

Optional id for the field root.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A <div class="shad-form-field"> tag.

See also

Other shadshiny tier-2 components: shad_calendar(), shad_checkbox(), shad_combobox(), shad_date_picker(), shad_input(), shad_input_group(), shad_input_otp(), shad_native_select(), shad_radio_group(), shad_select(), shad_slider(), shad_switch(), shad_textarea(), shad_toggle(), shad_toggle_group()

Examples

shad_form_field(
  shad_input("user", value = "shadcn"),
  label = "Username",
  description = "This is your public display name."
)
#> <div class="shad-form-field" data-shad="form-field">
#>   <label class="shad-label">Username</label>
#>   <input id="user" class="shad-input" type="text" value="shadcn"/>
#>   <p class="shad-form-field__description">This is your public display name.</p>
#>   <p class="shad-form-field__error" hidden></p>
#> </div>
